records.subject: Thermocell with identical gas electrodes and molten carbonate-based electrolyte
records.quote: The aim of this work is to develop a thermocell with identical gas electrodes using molten carbonate-based electrolytes.
context_quotes: The cell can generate power from waste heat, and can also utilize the CO2 rich off-gas available in metal producing industries.

records.subject: Dispersed solid oxide MgO content relative to eutectic (Li, Na)2CO3
records.quote: The addition of solid oxide to the molten carbonate melt alters also the system's Seebeck coefficient.
context_quotes: We report measurements where we vary the content of solid oxide in the liquid eutectic electrolyte mixture as well as the electrode gas flow rate.
